nodes.body: The import path points to `$lib/core/studio-state.svelte`, but the new module file added in this PR is `src/lib/core/studio-state.svelte.ts`. With an explicit `.svelte` extension in the specifier, bundler/TS resolution typically will not fall back to `.svelte.ts`, so this is likely a hard module-not-found build error.

`STUDIO_WEEKLY_MODES` / `STUDIO_MONTHLY_MODE_ID` are computed once at module load, but `getWeeklyModes()` / `getMonthlyMode()` are explicitly time-based (weekly/monthly rotation). In a long-lived SPA session (or on an SSR server process that stays up across week/month boundaries), these exports will become stale and the UI will keep showing the old rotation even after remounting the page.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recompute rotating modes per studio instance**

These constants freeze the weekly/monthly mode rotation when the module is first loaded, but `getWeeklyModes()`/`getMonthlyMode()` derive their results from `Date.now()`/`new Date()` in `src/lib/core/meechie-studio.ts`. On a warm SSR process that stays alive across a week or month boundary, the studio will keep serving the old mode set until the module is reloaded; the previous component script recomputed these values for each page instance.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Route network calls through seam adapters**

This new `src/lib/core` state class now performs browser network I/O directly via `postJson`; the repo instructions in `AGENTS.md` lines 83-85 say core logic must stay free of seam I/O and all network/process/filesystem I/O must flow through approved seam adapters. In this context, reusing or testing `StudioState` now reaches real `/api/meechie-studio-text`/generate/wig endpoints unless global `fetch` is patched, which bypasses the fixture-backed Seam-Driven Development contract path the repo requires.
